description_en: Retrieves the supported query conditions for querying exposed assets
description_zh: 获取查询暴露资产时支持的查询条件
name: DescribeExposedInstanceCriteria

parameters.help_en:
The value of the query condition. Fuzzy match is supported.

This parameter supports queries by asset name, asset ID, public IP address of the asset, private IP address of the asset, exposed component, exposed port, or exposed IP address
parameters.help_zh:
指定查询条件的值，支持模糊匹配。

该参数支持暴露资产的资产名称、资产编号、资产公网IP地址、资产私网IP地址、暴露组件、暴露端口、暴露IP地址查询
parameters.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the member account in the resource directory.
Call the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号ID。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

CriteriaList.description_en: The supported query conditions for querying exposed assets
CriteriaList.description_zh: 查询暴露资产时支持的查询条件

Name.description_en: The name of the query condition

Type.description_en:
The type of the query condition. Valid values:
input: requires manual input of the query content.
select: requires selecting a value from the options list (the Values field)
Type.description_zh:
查询条件的类型。取值：
input：输入型。表示使用该查询条件进行查询时需要手动输入查询内容。
select：选择型。表示使用该查询条件进行查询时需要从选择项列表（即Values值）中选择

Values.description_en:
The available option values when Type (the type of the query condition) is select.
When Type (the type of the query condition) is input, this parameter returns an empty value
Values.description_zh:
Type（查询条件的类型）为select时，可选项的值。
Type（查询条件的类型）为input时，该参数返回值为空

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
